query:
WITH new_room AS (
                   INSERT INTO rooms (name, created_by)
                   VALUES ($1, $2)
                   RETURNING id, name, created_by, created_at
               ), join_creator AS (
                   INSERT INTO room_memberships (room_id, user_id)
                   SELECT id, $2 FROM new_room
               )
               SELECT id, name, created_by, created_at FROM new_room
